slots.table:
-- the table a metric's value comes from: its `value` field's source, else the first source it names
SELECT split_part(source, '.', 1) AS t
FROM metric_sources()
WHERE metric = $metric AND source IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN field = 'value' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
LIMIT 1
slots.columns:
-- the unserved columns of the metric's table a `dimension` gloss or an applicable relevance verdict admits: gloss first, then by relevance
WITH axisless AS (
  SELECT metric FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND cardinality(dims) = 0 AND axes_basis <> 'authored'
),
sources AS (
  SELECT s.metric, s.field, s.source
  FROM metric_sources() s JOIN axisless ON axisless.metric = s.metric
  WHERE s.source IS NOT NULL
),
tab AS (
  SELECT metric, t FROM (
    SELECT metric, split_part(source, '.', 1) AS t,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY CASE WHEN field = 'value' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS rn
    FROM sources
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
served AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT metric, split_part(source, '.', 2) AS column_name FROM sources
),
cols AS (
  SELECT tab.metric, tab.t, c.column_name, c.ordinal_position
  FROM tab
  CROSS JOIN current_dataset d
  JOIN information_schema.columns c ON c.table_schema = d.dataset AND c.table_name = tab.t
  LEFT JOIN served ON served.metric = tab.metric AND served.column_name = c.column_name
  WHERE served.column_name IS NULL
),
gloss AS (
  SELECT subject, json_get_str(value, 'value') AS stance
  FROM GLOSSARY() WHERE aspect = 'dimension' AND state = 'current'
),
roles AS (
  SELECT subject, json_get_str(value, 'value') AS role_word
  FROM GLOSSARY() WHERE aspect = 'role' AND state = 'current'
),
verdict AS (
  SELECT subject, json_get_bool(value, 'applicable') AS applicable, json_get_float(value, 'relevance') AS relevance
  FROM (
    SELECT m.subject, m.value, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY m.subject ORDER BY m.computed_at DESC) AS rn
    FROM measurements m JOIN current_dataset d ON m.dataset = d.dataset
    WHERE m.aspect = 'dimension_relevance'
  ) WHERE rn = 1
),
pool AS (
  SELECT cols.metric, cols.t, cols.column_name, cols.ordinal_position,
         gloss.stance, roles.role_word, verdict.applicable, verdict.relevance,
         (gloss.stance IS NOT NULL OR verdict.applicable IS NOT NULL) AS judged
  FROM cols
  LEFT JOIN gloss ON gloss.subject = cols.t || '.' || cols.column_name
  LEFT JOIN roles ON roles.subject = cols.t || '.' || cols.column_name
  LEFT JOIN verdict ON verdict.subject = cols.t || '.' || cols.column_name
),
admitted AS (
  SELECT metric, column_name,
         CASE stance WHEN 'primary' THEN 0 WHEN 'supporting' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS stance_rank,
         COALESCE(relevance, 0.0) AS relevance, ordinal_position
  FROM pool
  WHERE stance IN ('primary', 'supporting') OR (stance IS NULL AND applicable)
)
SELECT array_to_string(array_agg(column_name ORDER BY stance_rank, relevance DESC, ordinal_position), ', ') AS columns
FROM admitted WHERE metric = $metric

-- the table of the first measurement the metric's row wants
SELECT split_part(wanted_over[1], '.', 1) AS wanted_table
FROM metric_axes() WHERE metric = $metric AND cardinality(wanted_over) > 0
slots.metrics:
-- the applicable metrics, by name
SELECT array_to_string(array_agg(metric ORDER BY metric), ', ') AS metrics
FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable
slots.n:
-- how many metrics are applicable
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable
slots.red_metric:
-- the metric whose newest complete walked point sits furthest from its corridor's median — what the bands detector scored
WITH walked AS (
  SELECT metric, period, COALESCE(partial, false) AS partial, displacement,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY point_seq DESC) AS rn
  FROM band_points() WHERE point_seq IS NOT NULL
),
newest AS (
  SELECT a.metric,
         CASE WHEN a.partial THEN b.period ELSE a.period END AS period,
         CASE WHEN a.partial THEN b.displacement ELSE a.displacement END AS displacement
  FROM walked a LEFT JOIN walked b ON b.metric = a.metric AND b.rn = 2
  WHERE a.rn = 1
)
SELECT metric FROM newest WHERE displacement IS NOT NULL ORDER BY displacement DESC, metric LIMIT 1
slots.red_period:
-- that point's period
WITH walked AS (
  SELECT metric, period, COALESCE(partial, false) AS partial, displacement,
         row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY metric ORDER BY point_seq DESC) AS rn
  FROM band_points() WHERE point_seq IS NOT NULL
),
newest AS (
  SELECT a.metric,
         CASE WHEN a.partial THEN b.period ELSE a.period END AS period,
         CASE WHEN a.partial THEN b.displacement ELSE a.displacement END AS displacement
  FROM walked a LEFT JOIN walked b ON b.metric = a.metric AND b.rn = 2
  WHERE a.rn = 1
)
SELECT period FROM newest WHERE displacement IS NOT NULL ORDER BY displacement DESC, metric LIMIT 1
slots.refusal:
-- the cube's reason for refusing a claimed measure's grounding; a relation and a fact serve no number by design, and a stop is the author's word
SELECT a.reason
FROM metric_axes() a
JOIN metric_surfaces s ON s.name = a.metric
WHERE a.metric = $metric AND NOT a.applicable AND s.stopped = '' AND s.kind NOT IN ('relation', 'fact')
slots.body:
-- the standing grounding of a metric, as written
SELECT value FROM GLOSSARY() WHERE subject = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset) AND aspect = $metric AND state = 'current'
slots.metric_list:
-- the applicable metrics, quoted for an IN list
SELECT array_to_string(array_agg('''' || metric || '''' ORDER BY metric), ', ') AS metric_list
FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable

surfaces.name: structure
surfaces.goal: the tables landed, the join structure declared and checked

route.when: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM imports WHERE dataset = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sources)
route.say: declare the source the files come from
route.why: no source is declared and no table is landed
route.form: DECLARE SOURCE <name> SET (type: parquet, location: '<the root the files sit under>');

route.when: SELECT name FROM sources WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM imports WHERE dataset = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset))
route.why: {row.name} is declared and no table is landed; a recipe lands one table, typed, and nothing more
route.form: SELECT path, size FROM source_files('{row.name}')
route.then: DECLARE RECIPE <table> ON {dataset} FROM {row.name} AS $$SELECT * FROM read_parquet('<path under the root>')$$;

route.when: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements WHERE dataset = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset) AND function = 'detect_relationships')
route.why: the candidates come from the detector; you judge them
route.form: SELECT detect_relationships() FROM {dataset}

route.when: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM relationships WHERE dataset = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset))
route.say: declare the edges you judge from the candidates
route.why: no edge is declared; the detector's candidates stand
route.form: SELECT * FROM relationship_candidates('{dataset}')

route.when: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM measurements WHERE dataset = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset) AND function = 'relationship_coherence')
route.say: run the coherence check over the declared edges
route.why: edges declared and never checked: orphan rate, child before parent
route.form: SELECT relationship_coherence() FROM {dataset}

route.done: tables landed, edges declared and checked

surfaces.name: metrics
surfaces.goal: every metric the dataset claims served, or stopped

route.when: SELECT name FROM aspects WHERE kind = 'query' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_surfaces)
route.why: {row.name} is declared and no dataset claims it: its definitions entry or its grounding makes it this dataset's
route.form: GLOSS definitions ON {dataset} AS $${"definitions": {"{row.name}": {"unit": "<unit>", "meaning": "<what it measures, in the business's words>"}}}$$;

route.when: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_surfaces)
route.why: no metric is claimed by this dataset: a declared QUERY aspect is this dataset's once its definitions entry or its grounding stands; the names are the human's

route.when: SELECT name FROM metric_surfaces WHERE NOT grounded AND stopped = ''
route.why: {row.name} is declared and not grounded: a declaration nobody grounds holds this goal — ground it, or stop it with the reason no number is served

route.when: SELECT metric, reason FROM metric_axes() WHERE NOT applicable AND cardinality(wanted) = 0
route.why: {row.metric} is grounded and the cube refuses the grounding — {refusal}. A grounding the cube cannot serve holds this goal: re-record it, or stop it with the reason no number is served
route.form:
GLOSS {row.metric} ON {dataset} AS $${body}$$;
-- or, where no number should be served: GLOSS {row.metric} ON {dataset} AS $${"stopped": "<what is missing, and why no number is served>"}$$;

route.done: every metric the dataset claims is served or stopped; the next concept is the human's to name

surfaces.name: slices
surfaces.goal: every applicable metric admits an axis

route.when: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable)
SELECT * FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND cardinality(wanted) > 0
route.why: {row.metric} reads {row.wanted_over[0]} and no verdict stands on it
route.form: SELECT {row.wanted[0]}() FROM {dataset}.{row.wanted_over[0]}

route.when: SELECT * FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND NOT judged_current
route.why: the verdicts {row.metric} stands on predate the last change
route.form:
SELECT temporal() FROM {dataset}.{table}.<date column>;
SELECT dimension_relevance() FROM {dataset}.{table}.<served column>

route.when: SELECT * FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND array_has(unadmitted_act, 'verdict')
route.why: {row.unadmitted_why[0]}
route.form: SELECT dimension_relevance() FROM {dataset}.{table}.{row.unadmitted[0]}

route.when: SELECT * FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND array_has(unadmitted_act, 'unserved')
route.say: serve {row.unadmitted[0]} in {row.metric}, or drop it from its axes
route.why: {row.unadmitted_why[0]}
route.form: GLOSS {row.metric} ON {dataset} AS $${body}$$;

route.when: SELECT * FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND array_has(unadmitted_act, 'abstained')
route.say: admit {row.unadmitted[0]} on {row.metric} by gloss, or declare the edge
route.why: {row.unadmitted_why[0]}
route.form: GLOSS dimension ON {dataset}.{table}.{row.unadmitted[0]} AS $${"value": "supporting"}$$;

route.when: SELECT * FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND cardinality(dims) = 0
route.why: the frame serves only a date and a value; a verdict or a gloss admits {columns} of {table} as an axis, and the cube slices only on served columns. Serve the axis as the frame's own column, or a label reached through a declared edge by a LEFT JOIN: the total must hold, and the write's row says what changed against the standing frame
route.form:
-- admitted and not served: {columns}; the frame's own column, or a LEFT JOIN to a label — the total must hold. A distinct count or a ratio, which no column slices whole, says "axes": [] instead; a flow serves the axis
GLOSS {row.metric} ON {dataset} AS $${body}$$;

route.when: SELECT * FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND cardinality(dims) = 0
route.why: the frame serves only a date and a value; {unjudged} carries the dimension role and no verdict
route.form: {relevance_form}

route.when: SELECT * FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable AND cardinality(dims) = 0
route.say: judge the unserved columns of {table}, none is judged
route.why: the frame serves only a date and a value, and no unserved column of {table} carries a verdict; the detector admits or abstains, one column per statement, and the line names the admitted
route.form: {relevance_form}

route.done: every applicable metric admits an axis, its grounding lists its own, or no judged column of its table can be one

surfaces.name: bands
surfaces.goal: the bands walk stands and no band is red

route.when: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM metric_axes() WHERE applicable)
SELECT * FROM owed WHERE kind = 'never measured' AND subject = 'metric_bands'
route.why: {row.why}
route.form: SELECT metric_bands() FROM {dataset}

route.when: SELECT * FROM owed WHERE kind = 're-measure' AND subject = 'metric_bands'
route.why: {row.why}
route.form: SELECT metric_bands() FROM {dataset}

route.when: SELECT 1 FROM ruling_entries WHERE dataset = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset) AND aspect = $red_metric AND key = 'band-' || $red_period AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ATTEST() WHERE witness = 'bands_w' AND band = 'red')
route.done: the walk stands; the red on {red_metric} at {red_period} carries the human's ruling

route.when: SELECT 1 FROM open_questions WHERE dataset = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset) AND aspect = $red_metric AND key = 'band-' || $red_period AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ATTEST() WHERE witness = 'bands_w' AND band = 'red')
route.blocked: {red_metric} is red at {red_period} and the question stands for the human

route.when: SELECT 1 FROM ATTEST() WHERE witness = 'bands_w' AND band = 'red'
route.why: the newest complete point of {red_metric} sits outside its corridor at {red_period}; a shift and a defect breach alike. A defect is the grounding's to fix; a shift is the human's to hear — record it as an assumption under the key band-{red_period}, and the docket asks
route.form: SELECT period, actual, p05, p50, p95, pit, partial FROM band_points() WHERE metric = '{red_metric}' ORDER BY point_seq

route.when: SELECT subject, witness FROM ATTEST() WHERE witness = 'bands_w' AND band = 'red'
route.say: read the walk behind the red verdict on {row.subject}
route.why: {row.witness} bands {row.subject} red and the walk names no complete point
route.form: SELECT metric, period, displacement FROM band_points() ORDER BY displacement DESC

route.done: the walk stands and no band is red, or the red carries a question or a ruling

surfaces.name: checks
surfaces.goal: a check of your own stands, every check ran, none is red

route.when: SELECT * FROM owed WHERE kind = 're-measure'
route.why: {row.why}
route.form: SELECT {row.subject}() FROM {dataset}

route.when: SELECT * FROM owed WHERE kind = 'never measured'
route.why: {row.why}
route.form: SELECT {row.subject}() FROM {dataset}

route.when: SELECT subject, witness FROM ATTEST() WHERE band = 'red' AND witness IS DISTINCT FROM 'bands_w'
route.why: {row.witness} bands {row.subject} red; the walk's own witness is the bands goal's
route.form: SELECT subject, aspect, witness, band, score FROM ATTEST({dataset}) WHERE band = 'red' ORDER BY witness, subject

route.when: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM functions WHERE scope = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset))
route.say: promote a reconciliation to a standing check
route.why: no check is owed and none is yours: a tie-out you ran by hand is a check that re-runs at every pin move

route.done: your own checks stand, every check ran, none is red

surfaces.name: app
surfaces.goal: a page over the grounded metrics

surfaces.goal: every ruling folded in, nothing owed

route.when: SELECT aspect AS metric, * FROM ruling_entries WHERE dataset = (SELECT dataset FROM current_dataset) AND NOT folded_in
route.why: {row.note}
route.form:
-- the assumption under key "{row.key}" at confidence 1.0 with basis "human-ruled"; an unclear stance is a reformulation under a new key
GLOSS {row.aspect} ON {row.subject} AS $${body}$$;
